motivation: PA-NF v4 improved biological recovery, scanner alignment, and scanner exclusion versus an exact-capacity no-inverse control, while failing transport-gain gates. A read-only audit localized the dominant error to the bottlenecked encoder-decoder transport path: direct scanner-operator calibration losses were low while end-to-end transport through the biological bottleneck remained negative. V5 prospectively decouples operator transport from biological sufficiency instead of tuning v4 on its used data.
primary_hypothesis: explicit inverse acquisition transport before biological encoding improves reference-gauge biological factorization, while scanner transport should be evaluated directly in feature space rather than through a low-dimensional biological reconstruction bottleneck

architecture.decoder_role: decode biological representation to the reference-scanner feature x_0 only; decoder is not part of the scanner-transport metric
architecture.operator_transport_metric: x_s -> T_s^-1(x_s) -> T_t(.) with no biological encoder or decoder in the path
architecture.scanner_operator_family: independently parameterized invertible orthogonal-basis plus diagonal-log-scale plus shift operators, unchanged from v4

synthetic_benchmark.generator_family: same independently sampled invertible acquisition-transform family as v4

training.removed_v4_objective: no cross-scanner reconstruction through biological decoder

requirements: candidate and control parameter counts exactly equal
max operator inverse roundtrip MSE across candidate/control < 1e-8
candidate mean operator-only known-scanner transport gain > 0
candidate mean operator-only heldout-scanner transport gain > 0
candidate mean heldout biological-latent recovery R2 >= 0.80
candidate-minus-control heldout biological R2 lower 95% bootstrap bound > 0
control-minus-candidate heldout canonical alignment MSE lower 95% bootstrap bound > 0
candidate-minus-control heldout same-identity retrieval lower 95% bootstrap bound >= 0
control-minus-candidate known-scanner probe accuracy lower 95% bootstrap bound > 0

interpretation_rules.pass: supports explicit inverse acquisition transport before biological encoding on a fresh synthetic benchmark when operator transport and biological sufficiency are evaluated as separate capabilities
interpretation_rules.operator_transport_pass_biology_fail: operator family works but inverse canonicalization does not improve biological factorization under this benchmark
interpretation_rules.biology_pass_operator_transport_fail: inverse canonicalization helps factorization but current operator learning remains inadequate even when measured directly
interpretation_rules.fail_both: do not continue this exact mechanism on the same synthetic family without a new hypothesis

claim_boundary: V5 is synthetic development evidence only. It does not establish real-scanner invertibility, clinical robustness, additive group structure, or WSI-level predictive benefit.

reproducibility.required_cuda_environment: CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8 before Python starts when running on CUDA
